angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,871,433 km at 99.95 pc = 0.25 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.0049 +/- 0.0202 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 99.95 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 2.69 +/- 0.04 solar radii from Mounzer et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KELT-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...668A...1M/abstract): 1,871,433 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.44 +/- 0.07 solar masses from Mounzer et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of KELT-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...668A...1M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5375 +/- 25 K from Mounzer et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...668A...1M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Mounzer et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...668A...1M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kelt-11.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.737, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-11 (pscomppars): spectral type G8/K0 IV, from Michigan Catalog, Vol. 5 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1999mctd.book.....H/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-11 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.17 dex, from Mounzer et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...668A...1M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-11 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.74429, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/ApJ/725/875/table1 (Chromospheric activity for CPS stars), column Prot: 40 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

rotationPeriodsCatalogued.source: VizieR J/ApJ/725/875/table1 (Chromospheric activity for CPS stars), column Prot: 40 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-11 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.99 km/s, from Mounzer et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...668A...1M/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (2.69 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.585. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
